translated: The future is bright.
It's great to have young people like that supporting us.
Isn't it?
Thank you.
All right, I'll read one last piece of mail.
This one is from Radio name: Suiha.
Thank you.
"Noguchi-san, Machico-san, kon-wonderhoi!"
Hello!
"My way of spending time at home is playing ProSeka."
Thank you!
Thanks!
"I love rhythm games, but lately I've been catching up on the stories."
"I've read the Leo/need and WxS stories,"
"and they're all so memorable that I can't fit them all in my favorites list."
Oh, wow.
That's what they wrote.
Thank you so much.
So they're reading the stories while playing the rhythm game.
ProSeka really does put so much effort into writing these stories, don't they?
They really do.
It makes them so worth reading.
Every unit has such a different, rich story unfolding.
Yeah, the stories are really incredible.
I hope you keep enjoying them to the fullest.
And you can go back and watch the past ones, too.
That's true.
It's such a nice feature.
Whether you just started or you've been playing for a long time.
Exactly.
